# exifr 7.1.3

The unmodified `dist/lite.umd.js` bundle from the official npm package is served
locally as `exifr-lite-7.1.3.umd.js`. No external script request is needed.

- Project: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/exifr/-/exifr-7.1.3.tgz
- License: MIT, included in `LICENSE.txt`.
- Bundle SHA-256: `530dbaef11cd9d4d65f108abc159b113580eb3dbd7bc69cd1364e25dd40413f9`
- Package SHA-256: `cf2515f5eed3a60ed33d5d4ad709af6acbe5d69a36e0d36924d80cb8b66a0dc2`

The lite bundle reads JPEG TIFF/EXIF. The upload reader disables XMP parsing,
automatic date revival, translated enum values, and silent parser errors.
